Answer: F
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates widening of the right paratracheal stripe, which is a classic radiographic sign of right paratracheal lymphadenopathy. While other masses like bronchogenic cysts can occur in this location, lymphadenopathy is the most common cause of a right paratracheal mass in an adult presenting with shortness of breath.
